description: A React-like component for listing and managing notes in a frontend application. It uses LightningJS components and interacts with a NoteService for data operations.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches all notes and updates the view.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters notes based on the search query.

methods.name: ensureOnSelect
methods.description: Ensures the onSelect callback is called with the currently focused note.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query and filters the list.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new note and updates the list.

methods.name: $rowColor
methods.description: Determines the row color based on selection.

methods.name: $rowAlpha
methods.description: Determines the row transparency based on selection.
